name_zh: 保留旋转的应变约束修复
formal_object: Per-face nonsingular positively oriented deformation F=R S, R in SO(3), S symmetric positive definite; declared stretch bounds 0<l<=u.

operations.condition: det F>0 and a well-defined polar decomposition

operations.output: Clip stretch eigenvalues while preserving R

derivation_steps.statement: Take the polar decomposition F=R S with S=(F^T F)^(1/2).
derivation_steps.justification: Nonsingular orientation-preserving F has a proper orthogonal polar factor.

derivation_steps.statement: For S=Q diag(s_j)Q^T, the Frobenius-nearest bounded S' is Q diag(clip(s_j,l,u))Q^T.
derivation_steps.justification: Orthogonal invariance and separable scalar projection on the eigenvalue interval.

derivation_steps.statement: Set F'=R S' and re-integrate the resulting differential targets.
derivation_steps.justification: Local rotations are retained; global reconstruction introduces an integrability projection.

assumptions: A nonsingular local square deformation map must first be qualified. A surface triangle alone does not supply a full-rank 3D map; any frame completion must be explicit and shared by controls. det F>0 is required; reflected/degenerate cases are not silently treated as valid polar states.
Real motion may include legitimate stretching outside [l,u].
The common integration backend must be fixed; local R preservation does not guarantee global motion preservation.
Bounds are learned/frozen on development evidence with no label leakage.
method_expression: Project only the stretch spectrum of each local deformation, preserve its rotation, and reconstruct an anchored mesh from those targets.
distinguishing_prediction: Stretch-heavy artifacts should respond more than nearly rigid motion; excessive strain limits should visibly remove legitimate deformations and lose CD-M.
falsifier: Reject if ordinary ARAP/elasticity regularization matches the native frontier or if genuine stretch is consistently damaged.
closest_alternative: Classical polar strain limiting; historical m01 elasticity; STAC local rigidity.
decisive_comparison: Native base, ARAP/elastic repair and rotation-preserving stretch projection with identical lift/tuning budgets; inspect all scores and retain invalid-face cases.
operational_delta: Selectively changes strain instead of all displacements; strong classical/old-module collision risk remains.
feasibility_and_cost: Per-face 3x3 decomposition plus a common sparse solve; safe handling of degenerate geometry is required.
structural_signature: Nonlinear polar-coordinate stretch projection followed by reconstruction.
algebra_review_basis: Checked positive orientation assumptions and spectral projection. No global volume, collision or native-motion guarantee.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
